Before you use them everywhere

These aren't fonts in the usual sense. Each letter is swapped for a different Unicode character that looks like a styled letter, which is why the style survives pasting. Two things follow from that:

  • Screen readers may not read them. Some read each letter as a maths symbol, some skip it. Keep names, prices and anything important in plain text, and style a word or a heading rather than the whole post.
  • Search can't find them. A styled word in your bio or caption won't match a search for the plain word, so keep keywords and hashtags plain.

Characters a font has no version of, such as accented letters or punctuation, are left as they are.
